---
title: inif.flat
description: Flat parallel-array view of an InifDocument for high-throughput scans.
reference: inif.flat
---

`FlatTokenStore` is an analysis representation, not a replacement file
format. It exposes flat parallel arrays of token ids, strings, sequence
provenance, and sparse annotations — useful when you need to scan tokens
across samples without reconstructing Pydantic objects per token.
